# THM Addons 0.2.9 for Minecraft 1.21.11

**Requires Minecraft 1.21.11 and Meteor Client 1.21.11. This release is incompatible with Minecraft 26.2.**

HighwayBuilder gains a tabbed screen, custom presets and adaptive rates. This release also adds AntiPhase, song recording and a Packets HUD.

## ⚠️ Breaking

- **HighwayBuilder:** The old `new-breaking` and `instantly-rebreak-echests` settings are replaced by EChest break modes. Check your preferred mode after updating.
- **HighwayBuilder:** EChest, render and debug settings have moved to new groups. Review those settings after updating.
- **Homes GUI:** The `/homes` interface from 0.2.8 has been removed.

## Highway Builder

- **Offhand EChest restock hotfix:** Keep echests through restock recovery with `minimum-empty-slots` set to `0`; handle full inventories safely and keep a suitable mining pickaxe selected.
- **Tabbed screen and presets:** Find settings by tab or search, and save and apply named custom presets.
- **Adaptive mining and placing:** Optional rates respond to server-reverted blocks and recover after stable operation.
- **Packet Build:** Normal-rate packet placement can wait for server updates; improved behind checks repair missing floor and railings.
- **Ender chest restock:** Choose Speedmine, instant rebreak, on-place rebreak or normal breaking. Restock and KitBot enclosures now use ordinary placement.
- **Status and diagnostics:** The HUD shows place rate and restock ETA; an optional session summary reports distance, blocks, restocks and setbacks.

## PvP and visuals

- **AntiPhase:** Place scaffolding inside a target to stop pearl phasing.
- **EXP Thrower:** Throw XP from inventory and optionally stop when Mending armor is repaired.
- **Pop Chams:** Show the player's skin and optional cape on the pop ghost.
- **Nametags:** Optionally show totem-pop counts.

## Utility

- **Notebot Stealer:** Record nearby noteblock songs as `.nbs`; Notebot can import Future `.notebot` songs.
- **Packets HUD:** Show sent and received packet rates with separate filters.
- **Chunk refresh:** Use `F3 + A + S` to request fresh chunks from the server.
- **Loading terrain:** A Disconnect button provides a way out of a stuck loading screen.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Leonn170709/THM-Addons/compare/release0.2.8...release0.2.9

THM Addons 0.2.8

New Loadouts and Homes GUI, Friend Sync can now write friends directly into other clients, and HighwayBuilder gets a double-chest restock option plus much clearer error messages.

⚠️ Breaking

- API token now required for everything, not just posting. Member list, cape rendering, and highway status now need your THM API token (Authorization: Bearer) on every request, same as status/cape submissions already did. If you haven't set one yet, get it from the Discord bot's player panel (View/Regenerate API Token) — a short migration grace period is in place, but it will end.

New

- Loadouts: save/load named gear sets with /loadout save|load|delete|clear <name>, plus quicksave buttons on the inventory screen. Regear auto-refills a loadout's items from any open container.
- Homes GUI: /homes can now open a paginated, clickable chest-style screen instead of a chat list.
- Friend Sync — File mode: writes friends directly into other installed clients' friend lists (Wurst, BleachHack, LiquidBounce, Future, Lambda, Boze, AutismClient, AnarchyClient, RusherHack, Mio) instead of waiting for someone to join — pick which THM ranks get synced, plus Sync All and per-client Import/Export.
- Hole Jitter (PvP): randomly nudges you to sub-block positions while standing in a 1x1 hole, to throw off crystal-aura prediction.
- HighwayTraveler — Wasp mode: a new rigid flight-vector travel method (alongside Elytra Bounce) with its own Horizontal/Fall Speed settings — more aggressive than normal physics, use carefully on strict servers.
- Totem Pop HUD and Player List HUD (configurable ping/distance/hp/armor/totem columns).
- 9 new main-menu shaders: Cosmic Strands, Cyberfuji, End Portal, Formless, Grid Attractor, Lavalamp, Mandelbulb, Synthwave, Voxelworld.

Highway Builder

- Double Chest restock (default on): places a second ender chest next to your restock chest for a 54-slot double, where the server supports it.
- Food Types now accepts multiple items as a priority list instead of just one.
- Statistics Webhook can now send text, the proof screenshot, or both together (webhook-content).
- Fixed restock scanning ignoring anything past slot 27 in plugin-resized shulkers.
- Fixed KitBot restock occasionally losing kits — waits for KitBot to leave and gives dropped kits extra time before breaking the enclosure.
- Fixed Apply Profile doing nothing when re-applying the profile you're already using.
- Fixed Send-Status not being disabled in creative/off-6b6t like the statistics toggle already was.
- Restock error messages now say what went wrong and how to fix it instead of generic internal failures.
- Recognizes 6b6t mirror domains (6b6t.cc, 6b6t.me, etc.), not just 6b6t.org.
- Removed the "Restart Detected" line from the stats summary.
- Air Place Mode's default changed from Never to Smart.
- New Always Use THM Speedmine + Validate Block digging toggles, syncing THM Speedmine's own Validate Break setting.

PvP — THM Speedmine

- New Auto-Mine Only, Feet First (breaks an enemy's lowest block first, bedrock included), and Instant Client Remove settings.
- Breaking now finishes instantly instead of waiting a tick; Auto-Rebreak no longer stalls the rest of the pipeline.

Misc

- .uuid stats and .uuid info <name> — cracked/premium breakdown for the tab list, or a single player's status.
- Better Tab: fast-tab (caches the tab list, default on) and tab-heads (now off by default) for a big
- Fixed Meteor's Offhand module getting an item permanently stuck to your cursor.
- Fixed Xaero minimap/world map never saving the outer edge of your render distance.
- Nuker's packet-mine mode removes instamineable blocks client-side immediately, cutting visual lag.
- Death screen: opening chat/commands now works instead of doing nothing.
- Added a "Never" option to reduce-FPS-when-inactive.
- Fixed screenshot copy-to-clipboard on Linux (falls back to wl-copy/xclip).
- Shader picker now resizes to fit the screen instead of a fixed 3-column grid.

---
THM Addons 0.2.7

THM now restyles the whole Meteor GUI and the Highway Builder can build straight out of your offhand.

GUI

- THM theme — Meteor's windows now get the THM window look itself (gradient border, translucent body, title bar, _/x glyphs), not just a recolor.
- thm-color / thm-side-color — those two colors drive the entire theme; change them and everything follows. The per-element pickers in the GUI tab no longer apply while THM is active.
- blur — frosted backdrop behind each Meteor window, not the whole screen.
- im-high — joke toggle that warps world, HUD and GUI. Always off again after a restart.

PvP

- AntiMine (new) — reacts to your surround being mined: Pearl phases you into the block being broken, Clip stands on the shared corner of a mined-out 2×2 so your hitbox denies all four crystal spots.
- Phase is back to being just "toggle = throw a phase pearl"; both modules share the same pearl settings.
- CrystalAuraTHM — added raytrace, support placing (support-min-gain, support-delay) that no longer overplaces bases, rotate-on, render modes and on-screen damage text.
- Placement fix for everything that places blocks — snow layers, grass and other replaceable neighbours are no longer used as the click face. SurroundPlus silently failed to surround in snow before this.

Mining

- Speedmine bedrock-only — mines bedrock on servers with a bedrock plugin, one block at a time, with its own rotate/color/shape settings.
- auto-mine-bind — bind a key for hold-to-mine; unbound behaves as before.
- Nuker always clicks the nearest exposed side/corner, with the face, hit vector and rotation all agreeing.
- Reach checks now measure the way the server does (eyes → nearest point of the block), so blocks at the edge of your range stop getting skipped.

Highway Builder

- offhand-build — pickaxe in the main hand, obsidian in the offhand, nothing swaps slots; mining and placing share the tick. Turns Meteor's AutoTotem off while it owns the offhand and swaps a totem in at low health itself.
- Offhand stays stocked — partial stacks are topped up from your inventory, and a restock starts while you still have blocks instead of after you run dry mid-row.
- Both highway profiles enable offhand-build by default.
- Creative works — supplies its own blocks and tools, never hunts for shulkers that don't exist (and still never reports stats).
- debug-log now says why the builder is idle, every tick it does nothing.
- PaketLimiter allow-bursts — lets one tick exceed the packet limit up to burst-limit, at most once every 20 ticks.
- Stats code removed — unused timestamp; distance and block counts unchanged.
- ArrayList shows the active profile (Building / Digging / Custom).

Misc

- Fixed a drop desync when the builder throws items after aligning.
- Credit headers on every source file.
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3, Fabric API 0.141.6+1.21.11.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Leonn170709/THM-Addons/compare/release0.2.6...release0.2.7
